name: Rivals, Patrons + an active Quest
summary: Three Rivals hunting you, two Patrons on the books, a Quest already running with rumors banked.
unlocks: Core Rules p.85 — 'Check for Rivals': roll a D6, equal or under the number of Rivals and one has tracked you down and you MUST fight them
Core Rules p.78 — the Track crew task actually having a target
Core Rules p.91 — Rival item loss
Core Rules pp.83-84 — Patron job Benefits / Hazards / Conditions subtables
Core Rules pp.119-120 — Determine Quest progress, and 'Continue a Quest' as a step-6 battle option
note: Three Rivals means the p.85 check fires on a D6 of 1-3, so a forced Rival battle should appear within a turn or two rather than by luck. This is also the deliberate retest for W2-02 (the Turn 1 Quest that did not persist): the Quest is seeded here rather than won off a p.85 roll, so the p.119-120 progress path can be walked directly and independently of whether generation persists.

active_quest.name: The Hidden Coordinates
active_quest.description: Seeded by the QA scenario loader to reach the p.119-120 progress roll.
